# onairos

**Tag**: mobile

## 简介

Onairos is a flutter package to interact with the Onairos App and recieve user AI Data

## 官网

- 主页: https://onairos.uk
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/zd819/onairos-flutter
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/onairos
